summary_1line: As Nala loses everything to dice, Damayanti secretly sends their children away for safety before Nala is stripped of kingdom, wealth, and dignity.

image_candidates.scene_text: Damayanti quietly instructs the charioteer Varshneya to carry her young son and daughter away in Nala’s swift chariot before the kingdom collapses.
Nala removes his royal ornaments and walks out of the city in a single cloth while Damayanti, also simply clad, follows him into exile.
Golden-plumed birds snatch away Nala’s last cloth as they rise into the sky, revealing themselves as the very dice that ruined him.
